title: Final-Payment Clearance Periods and Closure Letter Timing, Placed Consumer Accounts
content:
Account Closure desk schedule for **Placed Consumer Accounts**. It gives, per placement stage, the number of business days after a final payment before that payment is treated as cleared, by payment channel, and the service time for issuing the paid-in-full or settled-in-full letter.

## Clearance periods (business days after the final payment)

| Stage | ACH bank debit | Debit card or credit card | Mailed check | Money order | Retail cash payment network |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Early-Out Placement | 7 | 3 | 10 | 5 | 1 |
| Primary Placement | 10 | 5 | 10 | 5 | 1 |
| Secondary Placement | 10 | 5 | 10 | 5 | 1 |
| Tertiary Placement | 10 | 5 | 10 | 5 | 1 |
| Warehouse Placement | 10 | 5 | 15 | 7 | 1 |
| Legal Review Placement | 10 | 5 | 15 | 7 | 1 |

## Closure letter service time

| Stage | Paid-in-full or settled-in-full letter issued within (business days after the final payment clears) |
|---|---|
| Early-Out Placement | 5 |
| Primary Placement | 7 |
| Secondary Placement | 7 |
| Tertiary Placement | 7 |
| Warehouse Placement | 10 |
| Legal Review Placement | 5 |

## Notes on the schedule

- One clearance figure covers both card channels: a debit-card final payment and a credit-card final payment at the same stage clear in the same number of business days.
- A retail cash payment network final payment clears in 1 business day at every stage.
- Early-Out Placement has the shortest ACH and card clearance (7 and 3 business days); Warehouse Placement and Legal Review Placement have the longest mailed-check and money-order clearance (15 and 7 business days).

*Hypothetical comparison:* a final payment by mailed check clears after 10 business days at Primary Placement and after 15 business days at Warehouse Placement.
